title: WHERE expression-index coverage match

scope.rationale: Covering-index analysis must recognize a query expression that exactly matches any expression-bearing index column, using the table cursor to normalize column references.
excluded_responsibilities: Full covering-index Select walk and scoring

external_source_responsibilities: Expression comparison and source-layout Index column metadata
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete private match helper is assigned and invoked by production covering-index analysis.

inputs: Query expression, index with optional expression list, and table cursor
outputs: True only when an XN_EXPR index column's expression compares equal
contracts.ownership: All expression and index objects are borrowed; no allocation or mutation.
contracts.state_and_results: Ordinary columns and missing expression lists do not match. Every expression column is checked in index order; first exact comparison returns true.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Malformed missing expression metadata returns false at the typed boundary rather than dereferencing absent storage.

representation_differences: Optional typed expression-list storage protects malformed native metadata while source assertions require it for expression indexes.

oracle.protocol: Construct mixed ordinary/expression indexes and compare matching, nonmatching, collated, cursor-remapped, and absent-expression-list query nodes through covering-index analysis.
oracle.normalization: Compare boolean match and covering-index walker result.

assurance.malformed_input: Absent column-expression storage returns false; production schema owners provide synchronized arrays.
assurance.continuation: No planner state is changed directly; the caller marks/prunes only on true.
assurance.performance: Linear in index column count, matching source.

integration.native_call_path: The production covering walker invokes the helper and marks expression-index coverage before selecting index-only or expression-index execution.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Yes. The production planner owns the exact comparison path.

independent_review.notes: Pinned-C trace, assurance, and independent review remain open.

known_blockers: Complete assurance and independent fidelity review.

implementation_spans: Complete pinned exprIsCoveredByIndex body and surrounding covering-index walker
Native schema Index layout, expression comparison, covering walker, and execution integration
assertions_branches_cleanup: Ordinary columns, all expression positions, exact match, no match, absent metadata, and cursor remapping reviewed
